The structure of NaCd crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing four atoms and two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows both Cd and Na centers adopting a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each (6 Cd and 6 Na), with neighbor distances ranging from 3.1321 to 3.4035 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all four sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between Na 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge and face sharing between Cd and Na 12-vertex polyhedra.
